evidence.S1: styles.css:22-25: `.empty-state > *` animates each child (icon svg, h1, p, .actions per index.html:16-24) with nth-child(2..4) delays of 100/200/300ms, so the chunks are 100ms apart.
evidence.S2: :22 `animation: ... 300ms ease-out both`; :35-40 `@keyframes empty-fade-in-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); filter: blur(4px) } }` is selected at :28 under no-preference.
evidence.S3: The default keyframe `empty-fade-in` (:31-33) is opacity only. The translate+blur keyframe is swapped in only inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` (:27-29). evidence.S4: No transform-origin and no edge slide; the only movement is a 12px rise.
